panels.title: Calls by agent and tool, for the range
panels.description: A calls, B failed, C refused, D p95 duration.

targets.query: { name =~ "execute_tool.*" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" } | count_over_time() by (span.matchmark.agent, span.gen_ai.tool.name)

{ name =~ "execute_tool.*" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.matchmark.agent, span.gen_ai.tool.name)

{ name =~ "execute_tool.*" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" && span.matchmark.tool.refused = true } | count_over_time() by (span.matchmark.agent, span.gen_ai.tool.name)

{ name =~ "execute_tool.*" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.matchmark.agent, span.gen_ai.tool.name)

panels.title: Latest tasks that failed or escalated
panels.description: A TraceQL search. Click a trace ID to open it.

targets.query: { name = "matchmark.task" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" && span.matchmark.task.outcome =~ "failed|escalated" } | select(span.matchmark.app, span.matchmark.project, span.matchmark.task, span.matchmark.task.outcome)

panels.title: Latest attempts that did not finish
panels.description: A TraceQL search. Click a trace ID to open it.

targets.query: { name = "matchmark.attempt" && span.matchmark.app =~ "${app:regex}" && span.matchmark.project =~ "${project:regex}" && span.matchmark.attempt.outcome != "finished" } | select(span.matchmark.app, span.matchmark.project, span.matchmark.task, span.matchmark.attempt, span.matchmark.attempt.outcome, span.matchmark.attempt.restorations)
